title: Contents Packout & Storage Closing Payment: Carrier Money Passed On by the Insured
content:
Carrier money is the insured's to pass on where the carrier does not pay the company. For the closing payment on an insurance-funded Contents Packout & Storage job: **when the linked claim file is in denied or withdrawn status, the closing payment carries every charge line on the job other than lines billed to customer, card surcharge lines and late fee lines, less the insurance postings on the job, never below zero; when the claim file is in any other status and contents-coverage carrier payments other than depreciation releases issued to the insured only are recorded on it, the closing payment carries the lesser of two amounts, the first being those payments and the second being the approved contents scope less the carrier denied line write-offs on the contents coverage less the insurance postings on the job, never below zero; in every other case nothing is added.**

## Reading the Insurance Claim Services claim file

| Claim file status | Contents-coverage payments to the insured only, other than depreciation releases | Closing payment carries |
|---|---|---|
| denied or withdrawn | any | every charge line other than customer-billed, card surcharge and late fee lines, less the insurance postings on the job, never below zero |
| any other | recorded | the lesser of those payments and (approved contents scope less carrier denied line write-offs less insurance postings), never below zero |
| any other | none, or only depreciation releases | nothing |

The approved contents scope is the total of the carrier's contents-coverage scope approvals on the file.

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

- Claim denied; non-customer lines 2,750.00; postings 0.00: 2,750.00.
- Claim settled; 1,200.00 paid to the insured only plus a 500.00 depreciation release to the insured only; scope 6,000.00, denied line write-offs 0.00, postings 5,100.00: the payments counted are 1,200.00, the second amount is 900.00, so 900.00.
